gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the ALLPOWERS R2500 V2 + SP037 400 W kit costs $0.476 per Wh through our link ($913.49 / 1,920 Wh), ships now, and needs 4.8 hours of full sun to refill at the panel's rated output. That is a lower price per Wh than every kit under $1,500 that StormWatts or PowerSized list, and a shorter rated refill than every kit priced near it.
standout_why: I compared against StormWatts (cited, 2026-11-08) and PowerSized best/solar-generator (2026-11-06). Both already work out price per Wh and refill hours, but only for EcoFlow, Jackery, Anker and BLUETTI kits, at November 8 prices or older. Neither lists any ALLPOWERS kit. Neither gives a cart-tested price, and neither compares a kit with its parts bought separately. Below $1,500, StormWatts' lowest price per Wh is BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W at $0.578 per Wh, which needs 12.2 hours to refill. Its kits that refill in about 6 hours cost $0.698 to $0.723 per Wh. I could not open theoutageready.com or either dealectric.com page (the certificate error came from our fetcher). solargenreview.com was not opened. So I have not ruled out that one of those pages already states this.
decides: The page's pick must ship now. On today's link prices, the ALLPOWERS R2500 V2 + SP037 (ships now, $913.49) beats the kits ChatGPT showed on both price per Wh and rated refill hours. The Jackery 2000 v2 bundle's 200 W panel is a pre-order shipping by Nov 28. The BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 2×200 W is a pre-order dispatching Nov 26, at $0.687 per Wh. That makes the ALLPOWERS kit a candidate for the ships-now value pick. Two caveats hold it back. First, ALLPOWERS' own S2000 Pro + SP037 listing says its polycrystalline panel gives about 55-65 W per 100 W, so the real refill is closer to 8 hours. Second, I found no measured usable capacity for the R2500 V2. Second option: if the shopper can wait for a pre-order, the BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 2×200 W stays the best-documented 2 kWh kit, at $1,424.05 and 5.2 hours rated refill. Separately, today's ALLPOWERS store shows the R3500 + SP037 at $1,803.10, not the $1,498 in our kit table. With the 12% APBF12 code that is $1,586.73, over the budget. Re-run the cart test before listing that kit under $1,500.
